title: The WordPress planner keeps a link only where the site goes and the plugin takes it
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-seeder/test/plan-wordpress-contract.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the results of the two cases whose names start with "🔒 a link slot keeps only" and "a planned link to the site is compared as a page".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 15).

Both named cases are 'ok': a bare '#', a plain-http link and a site path the template has no page or link for are pending ('unsupported-url' / 'unknown-page'); a tel: loses its spaces; a path with a query is kept only when the template links there exactly; the template's own link said back is 'unchanged'.
evidence: 05/10/2026, local stand, develop b21c158bc: Apply on ja-kinetic (WordPress) failed with 'Unsupported link: home-signal.cta.chip.url' and wrote nothing. Two real-model plans of that template wrote 1-3 links the plugin refuses and 15-18 links to pages the template does not have, per plan.
fence: Link slots (type url or target attr url) are checked against the plugin's own rule and the template's destinations before the contract write; the model's words in every other slot are untouched.
